title: Audu Sule Katagum
content:
Audu Sule Katagum is a Nigerian politician, architect and the current Wazirin Katagum of Katagum. He previously served as the deputy governor of Bauchi state.


== Early life and education ==
He was born in Bauchi State, Nigeria. He was an architect by profession before joining politics where he served as the deputy governor of Bauchi State.
